part.text: The current implementation has one monolithic generator and a separate server, with no config loading. I’m going to introduce a typed plugin context and keep `buildSite` as the compatibility entry point; built-ins will participate in the same ordered pipeline, while the dev server adapter will preserve `startDevServer` and its returned handle.
